emergency.headline: This sounds like an emergency. Call 112 now.
steps: Stay in a locked room if it's safe. Keep your phone with you.
If you can't talk, dial 112 and stay on the line, or press SOS in the 112 India app.
Keep the children with you if you can; Childline 1098 can also send help for them.
after: You can get protection, residence and other orders under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, through a Protection Officer or the Magistrate.
Free legal help: your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), or call 15100.
emergency.offer: When you're ready, I can help you write a police complaint.
